this_title: Modli se, jestli chceš, aby se země přiblížila a nebe promluvilo s tebou
trans_title: Pray If You Want the Earth to Come Closer and the Sky to Speak to You
introduction: The black-and-white video prayer stages a small miracle in the form of a minimalist one-shot study of a glass vase, water surface and light. It’s as if the hands, which regularly stir up the still life, are asking for more than the elements and the utilized technique can give.源自：https://www.ji-hlava.com/filmy/modli-se-jestli-chces-aby-se-zeme-priblizila-a-nebe-promluvilo-s-tebou
